title: ChatGPT Review Package — Output
description: The structured assessment a human imports back after running the input package through ChatGPT. Schema validity is necessary but not sufficient: scripts/import_review.py additionally applies the rejection rules in WO-010 Gate I (unknown evidence, missing transmission mechanisms, missing-as-zero, proxy presented as quotation, unsupported real-time congestion claims, unsupported causation, company-specific mandatory instructions) and blocks autonomous publication of High or Critical conclusions.

produced_at.description: When this OUTPUT was produced. This is an output-generation timestamp, not a binding field -- it must never be read as, or confused with, input_data_cutoff_at or input_source_cutoff below, which describe the INPUT package instead.

model_reference.description: Free-text record of which assistant produced the output, entered by the human reviewer. Provenance only -- the repository never calls an AI API.

input_package_sha256.description: Copied verbatim from the input package's own package_sha256. Binds this output to the exact package it was produced from; import is rejected if this does not match the package on disk.

input_dataset.description: Copied verbatim from the input package's own dataset. Must equal current_publication for this output to ever be approved into the current AI Outlook.

input_package_purpose.description: Copied verbatim from the input package's own package_purpose. Must equal current_intelligence_assessment for this output to ever be approved into the current AI Outlook.

input_data_cutoff_at.description: Copied verbatim from the input package's own data_cutoff_at. A mismatch means this output was produced against a different vintage of the package and cannot be approved without an explicit supersession.

input_source_cutoff.description: Copied verbatim from the input package's own source_cutoff.

current_situation.description: WO-010-R4 §1: a structured disposition, not a free-text sentence. Free-text wording alone must never be what determines whether a current conclusion is supported.

key_changes.description: WO-010-R4 §1: structured records, not plain strings. A key change must cite eligible support; with zero eligible support, this array must be empty or contain only change_type 'coverage_change' entries with no support references.

indicator_ids.description: series_id values from the input package's key_indicators that support this lane's direction. A direction other than insufficient_evidence must cite at least one evidence_id or indicator_id.
series_id values supporting whichever links above are populated. A chain with any populated link must cite at least one evidence_id or indicator_id.

evidence_references.description: Every evidence_id the assessment relies on. Import fails if any is not present in the corresponding input package.

highest_severity_claimed.description: The maximum severity anywhere in this output. 'high' or 'critical' forces human_review_required and blocks autonomous publication.

current_direction.description: A direction other than insufficient_evidence must cite at least one eligible, relevant evidence_id or indicator_id.

current_disposition.description: Whether this is a genuine assessment or a coverage-gap statement. Must be 'insufficient_evidence' whenever current_direction is, and whenever the package holds no eligible support at all.

change_type.description: 'coverage_change' is the only type permitted with empty evidence_ids and indicator_ids -- it describes a change in what the platform can see, not a change in the world.

comparison_period.description: What this change is measured against, e.g. a prior data_cutoff_at. Null when change_type is coverage_change.

indicator_ids.description: series_id values from key_indicators supporting this statement, where an indicator supports it.

series_id values supporting this impact claim. A numeric indicator alone can never establish an operational-condition impact (capacity, service, transport, logistics): those areas require at least one evidence_id.
